experiment: P5 H4 rare-event abstention plus conditional ranker OOF v1
status: post-OOF exploratory identity proposed after observing the direct ranker's over-action failure

observed_parent_result.motivation: direct ridge changed center on approximately 98 percent of horizons although only 824 of 43437 horizons had positive oracle headroom

stage_1_opportunity_detector.target: max signed robust value across 81 schedules is strictly positive
stage_1_opportunity_detector.model: class-weighted closed-form ridge, alpha 100, unpenalized intercept
stage_1_opportunity_detector.positive_weight: outer-train negatives divided by outer-train positives
stage_1_opportunity_detector.action_count: for each outer fold, round(eval rows times outer-train positive prevalence)
stage_1_opportunity_detector.selection: highest detector scores with stable row-index tie-break

stage_2_conditional_ranker.training_rows: only positive-opportunity rows in the outer training fold
stage_2_conditional_ranker.model: 81-output closed-form ridge, alpha 100, outer-positive normalization only
stage_2_conditional_ranker.inference: only on stage-1 selected rows; center score fixed to zero; argmax with lexicographic first tie-break
stage_2_conditional_ranker.abstention: all unselected rows and selected rows whose conditional argmax is center retain center

detector: recall at frozen fold action count
metrics.policy_proxy: sum of actual signed robust value at the OOF-selected schedule; diagnostic only, not WER

gates.decision: all gates pass only to unlock a separately preregistered independent calibration confirmation; never direct closed-loop or held-out unlock from this post-OOF reuse

forbidden: calibration, dev, test, held-out, or closed-loop outcomes
changing action count, alpha, features, folds, or gates after outcomes
calling this reused-fit OOF an independent confirmation or WER result
